# ChoscorUI app-author API

> Generated from the source doc comments. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `cargo run -p choscorui-api-docs --locked`.

This reference covers the API that an application uses: the items of `choscorui::prelude` and the extension points for custom controls, settings, and capabilities.
Every example assumes `use choscorui::prelude::*;`.

- App: [app--enums.md](app--enums.md), [app--functions.md](app--functions.md), [app--structs.md](app--structs.md), [app--traits.md](app--traits.md), [app--type-aliases.md](app--type-aliases.md)

## App

- [`AnyView`](app--structs.md#anyview) struct: A view of any type.
- [`App`](app--structs.md#app) struct: A view-based application.
- [`AppContext`](app--structs.md#appcontext) struct: A running application.
- [`AppError`](app--enums.md#apperror) enum: What can stop an application from starting.
- [`BackendCapabilities`](app--structs.md#backendcapabilities) struct: What the running backend can do.
- [`CommandMenu`](app--structs.md#commandmenu) struct: One menu of the menu bar, with `MenuChoice` rows: actions, check and radio rows, submenus, and separators.
- [`DesktopEvent`](app--enums.md#desktopevent) enum: An event that the desktop sends after the call that caused it, or without a call.
- [`DesktopListener`](app--type-aliases.md#desktoplistener) type alias: A function that `Services::listen` calls with each desktop event.
- [`Either`](app--enums.md#either) enum: One of two views, for a branch whose sides have different types.
- [`Empty`](app--structs.md#empty) struct: A view that shows nothing.
- [`FileDialogKind`](app--enums.md#filedialogkind) enum: What a file dialog chooses.
- [`FileDialogRequest`](app--structs.md#filedialogrequest) struct: A file dialog to show.
- [`NotificationDelivery`](app--enums.md#notificationdelivery) enum: What `Services::post_notification` did with a notification.
- [`NotificationPermission`](app--enums.md#notificationpermission) enum: Whether the user lets the application post notifications.
- [`Scene`](app--structs.md#scene) struct: A window to open: its options, its root view, an optional title that follows state, and an optional key that keeps its place between launches.
- [`ServiceError`](app--enums.md#serviceerror) enum: Why a service call failed.
- [`Services`](app--structs.md#services) struct: The desktop services of the running backend.
- [`ShortcutModifiers`](app--structs.md#shortcutmodifiers) struct: The modifier keys that are held with a key or a pointer event, or that a keyboard shortcut needs.
- [`StatusItemSpec`](app--structs.md#statusitemspec) struct: The item that an application shows in the system status area.
- [`Storage`](app--structs.md#storage) struct: The settings of an application, shared by its windows.
- [`StorageError`](app--enums.md#storageerror) enum: A problem with the settings that back stored state.
- [`StoredValue`](app--traits.md#storedvalue) trait: A value that stored state can hold: one of the `SettingValue` kinds.
- [`Support`](app--enums.md#support) enum: Whether a backend provides a feature.
- [`SystemNotification`](app--structs.md#systemnotification) struct: A notification to post.
- [`View`](app--traits.md#view) trait: A piece of user interface.
- [`ViewError`](app--enums.md#viewerror) enum: What can go wrong while the runtime updates a view tree.
- [`ViewHost`](app--structs.md#viewhost) struct: Mounts views on a retained tree and runs them: live properties, layout, paint, semantics, and input.
- [`WindowId`](app--structs.md#windowid) struct: Identifies an open window for the life of the application.
- [`WindowOptions`](app--structs.md#windowoptions) struct: The title and the content size of a window to open.
- [`capabilities`](app--functions.md#capabilities) function: What the current backend provides.

## State

- [`Binding`](state.md#binding) struct: A two-way handle to a value that something else owns: a `State`, a part of one, or a pair of closures.
- [`Branch`](state.md#branch) struct: A view that a key chooses: `Branch::new(move || tab.get(), |tab| page(*tab))`.
- [`Cx`](state.md#cx) struct: The mount context.
- [`Dynamic`](state.md#dynamic) struct: A view that a closure chooses.
- [`Env`](state.md#env) struct: Values that a view passes to every descendant.
- [`Fixed`](state.md#fixed) struct: Marks a fixed value for `IntoLive`.
- [`ForEach`](state.md#foreach) struct: Keyed children from a collection.
- [`Handle`](state.md#handle) struct: Marks a state handle for `IntoLive`.
- [`IntoLive`](state.md#intolive) trait: Converts a value, a closure, or a state handle into a `Live` property.
- [`Live`](state.md#live) enum: A view property: a fixed value, or a closure that reads state and runs again when that state changes.
- [`Memo`](state.md#memo) struct: A read-only value computed from state.
- [`Reading`](state.md#reading) struct: Marks a closure for `IntoLive`.
- [`Runtime`](state.md#runtime) struct: The reactive graph: typed properties and the connections between them.
- [`SettingValue`](state.md#settingvalue) enum: One stored setting value.
- [`Settings`](state.md#settings) struct: Settings for one application, backed by a file.
- [`SettingsSchema`](state.md#settingsschema) struct: Current version, defaults, and the migration chain.
- [`State`](state.md#state) struct: A value that a component owns.
- [`take_handle_errors`](state.md#take_handle_errors) function: Takes the errors of handles used after their component unmounted.

## Layout

- [`Alignment`](layout.md#alignment) struct: A position in a box along both axes.
- [`AspectRatio`](layout.md#aspectratio) type alias: A box with a fixed ratio.
- [`Divider`](layout.md#divider) struct: A thin line across a stack: horizontal in a vertical stack, vertical in a horizontal one.
- [`Dock`](layout.md#dock) type alias: Dockable panels around a center area, as `layout` arranges them.
- [`Field`](layout.md#field) struct: One form field: a label, a control, and an optional description and error.
- [`FieldContent`](layout.md#fieldcontent) struct: Text parts stacked 4 pt apart, such as a `FieldTitle` above a description, beside a choice control.
- [`FieldGroup`](layout.md#fieldgroup) struct: Whole fields stacked 28 pt apart, each filling the width.
- [`FieldOrientation`](layout.md#fieldorientation-1) enum: The look of a field label row.
- [`FieldSeparator`](layout.md#fieldseparator) struct: A rule between field groups, with optional text in its middle.
- [`FieldSet`](layout.md#fieldset) struct: Fields or other content under a legend, with an optional description between them, 24 pt apart.
- [`FieldTitle`](layout.md#fieldtitle) struct: A title inside a field's content, in the label style.
- [`Form`](layout.md#form) struct: Rows of labelled fields.
- [`FormRow`](layout.md#formrow) struct: One row of a `Form`: a field label and the field.
- [`Grid`](layout.md#grid) struct: Children in rows across the given columns, filled row by row.
- [`GridItem`](layout.md#griditem) enum: A column of a `Grid`.
- [`Group`](layout.md#group) struct: Mounts children without a node of its own, so that a modifier can apply to a group of views.
- [`HStack`](layout.md#hstack) struct: Children from the leading edge to the trailing edge; mirrored in right-to-left layouts.
- [`HorizontalAlignment`](layout.md#horizontalalignment) enum: Where children sit across a vertical stack.
- [`LayoutDirection`](layout.md#layoutdirection) enum: The reading direction: left-to-right or right-to-left.
- [`LazyHStack`](layout.md#lazyhstack) struct: Items from the leading edge to the trailing edge, mounted only while they show; mirrored in right-to-left layouts.
- [`LazyVStack`](layout.md#lazyvstack) struct: Items top to bottom, mounted only while they show in the enclosing scroll view or the window.
- [`Point`](layout.md#point) struct: A position in logical points.
- [`Rect`](layout.md#rect) struct: A half-open rectangle in logical points.
- [`Resizable`](layout.md#resizable) struct: Panes with a handle between each two neighbors.
- [`ScrollView`](layout.md#scrollview) struct: Content that scrolls along one axis.
- [`Size`](layout.md#size) struct: An extent in logical points.
- [`Space`](layout.md#space) enum: A step of the spacing scale, in units of the spacing token.
- [`Spacer`](layout.md#spacer) struct: Flexible space that takes what is left along a stack.
- [`SplitOrientation`](layout.md#splitorientation) enum: The axis along which a split view places its panes.
- [`VStack`](layout.md#vstack) struct: Children top to bottom.
- [`VerticalAlignment`](layout.md#verticalalignment) enum: Where children sit across a horizontal stack.
- [`ZStack`](layout.md#zstack) struct: Children on top of each other, later ones above.

## Controls

- [`Accordion`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#accordion) type alias: Stacked sections of (title, content); `open` edits the open sections.
- [`Alert`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#alert) type alias: A callout with a title and description.
- [`Attachment`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#attachment) type alias: A file with media, a detail line, and a progress state.
- [`Avatar`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#avatar) type alias: A round user image with a text fallback.
- [`AvatarGroup`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#avatargroup) type alias: Overlapping avatars named `name`, for example the members of a team.
- [`Badge`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#badge) type alias: A short status label.
- [`Breadcrumb`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#breadcrumb) type alias: A trail of links to the current page.
- [`Button`](controls--structs.md#button) struct: A push button that runs `action`: `Button::new(t!("save"), move || …)`.
- [`ButtonGroup`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#buttongroup) type alias: Joined members of a `controls::ButtonGroup`: toggles, buttons, separators, and text parts.
- [`Calendar`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#calendar) type alias: A month grid in the environment's locale; `selected` edits the chosen day.
- [`Card`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#card) type alias: A surface with a title and description.
- [`Carousel`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#carousel) type alias: Slides that move one at a time; `current` edits the shown slide.
- [`Chart`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#chart) type alias: A chart of application data.
- [`Checkbox`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#checkbox) type alias: A checkbox that edits `checked`.
- [`Collapsible`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#collapsible) type alias: A section that shows or hides its items; `open` edits whether it shows them.
- [`ColorPicker`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#colorpicker) type alias: A color picker: a swatch and hue, saturation, value, and alpha strips.
- [`ColumnBrowser`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#columnbrowser) type alias: Columns of a tree model, one level each: Right opens a row's children, and Left goes back.
- [`Combobox`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#combobox) type alias: A field with a list of suggestions; `selected` edits the chosen item.
- [`Command`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#command) type alias: A search input over grouped commands.
- [`CommandLink`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#commandlink) type alias: A command link: an arrow, a `title`, and a `description` line in one button, which runs `action`.
- [`ControlKind`](controls--enums.md#controlkind) enum: Every control the default recipe set can paint.
- [`DataTable`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#datatable) type alias: Sorted, filtered, and paged rows of the model that `model` makes; `selected` edits the selected rows.
- [`DatePicker`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#datepicker) type alias: A button with a calendar popover.
- [`DateTimeEdit`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#datetimeedit) type alias: A date, time, or date and time editor with one field for each part, in the order of the environment's locale.
- [`DecimalSpinBox`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#decimalspinbox) type alias: A locale-aware decimal field with steppers that edits `value` inside `bounds`.
- [`Dial`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#dial) type alias: A rotary control that edits `value`.
- [`EmptyState`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#emptystate) type alias: A centered empty state.
- [`FieldText`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#fieldtext) type alias: A legend, label, description, or error line of a form field.
- [`FontChooser`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#fontchooser) type alias: A font family combobox over `families`; `selected` edits the index of the chosen family.
- [`GroupBox`](controls--structs.md#groupbox) struct: A titled frame around related controls.
- [`HeaderView`](controls--structs.md#headerview) struct: A table header over `columns`.
- [`Input`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#input) type alias: A single-line text input that edits `value`.
- [`InputGroup`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#inputgroup) type alias: A text input with addons: text, icons, and buttons before, after, above, or below the text.
- [`InputOtp`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#inputotp) type alias: A one-time code input of `length` characters that edits `value`.
- [`IntegerRange`](controls--structs.md#integerrange) struct: Validated integer value state shared by integer range controls.
- [`ItemGroup`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#itemgroup) type alias: Rows of items, each with a title and optional media, description, header, footer, and action.
- [`Items`](controls--traits.md#items) trait: A list that a control shows: a fixed `Vec`, or a closure that makes it from the environment.
- [`Kbd`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#kbd) type alias: Key caps for a shortcut.
- [`KeySequenceEdit`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#keysequenceedit) type alias: A field that records a keyboard shortcut of up to `max_chords` chords.
- [`Label`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#label) type alias: Static text with the label recipe, for a caption next to a control.
- [`List`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#list) type alias: The rows of the model that `model` makes, one line of text each; `selection` edits the positions of the selected rows.
- [`Marker`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#marker) type alias: A muted line between chat messages.
- [`Menubar`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#menubar) type alias: A row of menu titles.
- [`Message`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#message) type alias: A chat message: the author's bubbles, with an optional avatar, header, and footer that `.with` adds.
- [`MessageScroller`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#messagescroller) type alias: A scroll area of `messages` that stays at the bottom while it shows the last message.
- [`NavigationMenu`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#navigationmenu) type alias: Site links whose triggers open panels.
- [`NumericDisplay`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#numericdisplay) type alias: A seven-segment display of `value` in `base`, with `digits` digits.
- [`Pagination`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#pagination) type alias: Page links with previous and next buttons; `page` edits the current page.
- [`Progress`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#progress) type alias: A progress bar that shows `value` of a maximum, 100 until `.maximum` changes it.
- [`Questionnaire`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#questionnaire) type alias: Questions that show one at a time, with Previous, Skip, Next, and Submit buttons that `labels` names.
- [`RadioGroup`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#radiogroup) type alias: Radio buttons, one for each option; `selected` edits the chosen option.
- [`RangeSlider`](controls--type-aliases-1.md#rangeslider) type alias: Low and high values along one track; `values` edits both.
- [`ScrollBar`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#scrollbar) type alias: A standalone scroll bar named `name` over `content` points, of which `viewport` show; `offset` edits the scroll position.
- [`Select`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#select) type alias: A trigger with a popup list; `selected` edits the chosen option.
- [`Sidebar`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#sidebar) type alias: Grouped navigation items; `selected` edits the chosen item.
- [`SizeGrip`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#sizegrip) type alias: A grip in the bottom trailing corner that resizes its window.
- [`Skeleton`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#skeleton) type alias: A pulsing placeholder block of `width` by `height` points.
- [`Slider`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#slider) type alias: A slider that edits `value`.
- [`SpinBox`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#spinbox) type alias: An integer field with steppers that edits `value`.
- [`Spinner`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#spinner) type alias: A spinning loader.
- [`StackedContainer`](controls--structs.md#stackedcontainer) struct: A stack of pages that shows one page at a time: the view that `page` makes for `current` fills the stack, as a child of the stack node.
- [`StatusBar`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#statusbar) type alias: A status bar that shows `message` at the start and `sections` at the end.
- [`Switch`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#switch) type alias: An on or off switch that edits `on`.
- [`Tabs`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#tabs) type alias: A tab list, one tab for each label; `selected` edits the chosen tab.
- [`TabsVariant`](controls--enums.md#tabsvariant) enum: The look of a tab list.
- [`TextEditor`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#texteditor) type alias: A multiline plain-text editor that edits `value`.
- [`TextField`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#textfield) type alias: A single-line text field that edits `value`.
- [`Textarea`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#textarea) type alias: A multiline text input that edits `value`.
- [`Toggle`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#toggle) type alias: A button that stays on or off and edits `on`.
- [`ToggleGroup`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#togglegroup) type alias: A row of toggles.
- [`ToolBox`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#toolbox) type alias: Pages under stacked headers, with one page open; `open` edits the index of the open page.
- [`ToolButton`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#toolbutton) type alias: A tool bar button that runs `action`.
- [`Toolbar`](controls--type-aliases-2.md#toolbar) type alias: A row of command buttons on the `area` edge of a window, with one tab stop and arrow keys between its items.

## Presentation

- [`AlertDialog`](presentation.md#alertdialog) type alias: A modal alert with a `title`, a `message`, and ordered `buttons`, open while `presented` is true.
- [`Announcer`](presentation.md#announcer) struct: The queue of spoken announcements of a view host.
- [`ContextMenu`](presentation.md#contextmenu) type alias: An area that opens `items` at the pointer on a secondary click.
- [`Dialog`](presentation.md#dialog) type alias: A trigger button with a modal panel; `open` edits whether it shows.
- [`DropdownMenu`](presentation.md#dropdownmenu) type alias: A button named `name` that opens a menu of `items`.
- [`FontDialog`](presentation.md#fontdialog) struct: A font dialog that edits `style`: a family combobox, a size field, bold and italic toggles, and a preview of `sample` in the chosen style.
- [`InputDialog`](presentation.md#inputdialog) struct: A modal dialog for one validated value.
- [`MenuChoice`](presentation.md#menuchoice) struct: One row of a menu that a view presents: an action, a checkbox or radio row, a submenu, or a separator.
- [`Popover`](presentation.md#popover) type alias: A trigger button with a floating panel; `open` edits whether it shows.
- [`SheetSide`](presentation.md#sheetside) enum: The edge a sheet slides in from.
- [`Toast`](presentation.md#toast) struct: One toast: a title, an optional description, a variant, and an optional action button.
- [`ToastPosition`](presentation.md#toastposition) enum: Where the toast stack sits in the window.
- [`ToastVariant`](presentation.md#toastvariant) enum: The look of a toast.
- [`Toaster`](presentation.md#toaster) type alias: The toasts of `toasts` in a stack at a corner of this view, named `name`.
- [`Toasts`](presentation.md#toasts) struct: The handle that the app pushes toasts through.

## Modifiers

- [`Edges`](modifiers.md#edges) struct: Padding on logical edges: `leading` is the start edge, which is the right edge in right-to-left layouts.
- [`Frame`](modifiers.md#frame) struct: Size constraints and the alignment of the content in the frame.
- [`Styled`](modifiers.md#styled) struct: A view with an ordered list of modifiers.
- [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) trait: The modifiers of every view.

### Layout modifiers

- [`aspect_ratio`](modifiers-layout.md#aspect_ratio) modifier: Keeps width ÷ height at `ratio`, with the width the view gets.
- [`fixed_size`](modifiers-layout.md#fixed_size) modifier: Keeps the view at its measured size when the parent overflows.
- [`frame`](modifiers-layout.md#frame) modifier: Size constraints, with the content aligned in the frame.
- [`hidden`](modifiers-layout.md#hidden) modifier: Hides the view but keeps its space.
- [`layout_direction`](modifiers-layout.md#layout_direction) modifier: The layout direction of the view, instead of the locale's.
- [`layout_priority`](modifiers-layout.md#layout_priority) modifier: A share of the leftover space along the parent stack.
- [`offset`](modifiers-layout.md#offset) modifier: Moves the painted view without changing its layout.
- [`padding`](modifiers-layout.md#padding) modifier: Space around the view, on all or on logical edges.

### Controls modifiers

- [`accessibility_busy`](modifiers-controls.md#accessibility_busy) modifier: Marks the view as busy while its content loads, such as a region of skeleton placeholders.
- [`accessibility_hidden`](modifiers-controls.md#accessibility_hidden) modifier: Hides the view and its descendants from assistive technology.
- [`accessibility_hint`](modifiers-controls.md#accessibility_hint) modifier: What happens when the view is used, for assistive technology.
- [`accessibility_label`](modifiers-controls.md#accessibility_label) modifier: The name that assistive technology reads.
- [`accessibility_role`](modifiers-controls.md#accessibility_role) modifier: The role that assistive technology reports for the view, for example `TabPanel` for the content of the selected tab.
- [`accessibility_value`](modifiers-controls.md#accessibility_value) modifier: The value that assistive technology reads.
- [`disabled`](modifiers-controls.md#disabled) modifier: Disables every control in the view.
- [`focusable`](modifiers-controls.md#focusable) modifier: Whether keyboard focus can stop on the view.
- [`focused`](modifiers-controls.md#focused) modifier: Keeps `focused` true while the view has keyboard focus; setting it moves focus to the view.
- [`keyboard_shortcut`](modifiers-controls.md#keyboard_shortcut) modifier: Runs `action` for `key` with `modifiers` while focus is in the view, or anywhere when no closer view declares the same keys.
- [`on_key_press`](modifiers-controls.md#on_key_press) modifier: Runs `action` for a press of `key` with no modifier keys while the keyboard focus is in the view.
- [`on_message`](modifiers-controls.md#on_message) modifier: Calls `handler` with each message of the view's control.
- [`on_press`](modifiers-controls.md#on_press) modifier: Runs `action` with the position of each primary press on the controls of the view, from the top-left corner of the view.
- [`on_submit`](modifiers-controls.md#on_submit) modifier: Runs `action` when the control commits its input, for example Return in a text input.

### Presentation modifiers

- [`alert_dialog`](modifiers-presentation.md#alert_dialog) modifier: Shows `content` in an alert dialog, which asks the user to confirm or cancel.
- [`context_menu`](modifiers-presentation.md#context_menu) modifier: Opens a menu of `items` at the pointer on a secondary click or a Control-click on the view, or for the `ShowMenu` action.
- [`dialog`](modifiers-presentation.md#dialog) modifier: Shows `content` in a dialog while `presented` is true.
- [`drawer`](modifiers-presentation.md#drawer) modifier: Shows `content` in a drawer along the `side` edge.
- [`dropdown_menu`](modifiers-presentation.md#dropdown_menu) modifier: Shows a menu of `items` below the view while `presented` is true.
- [`file_exporter`](modifiers-presentation.md#file_exporter) modifier: Shows the backend's save dialog, which starts with the file name `name`, while `presented` is true.
- [`file_importer`](modifiers-presentation.md#file_importer) modifier: Shows the backend's open dialog for one file with an extension in `types` (all files when empty) while `presented` is true.
- [`hover_card`](modifiers-presentation.md#hover_card) modifier: Shows `content` in a hover card next to the view after the pointer rests on the view, or after keyboard focus moves into it.
- [`popover`](modifiers-presentation.md#popover) modifier: Shows `content` in a popover next to the view.
- [`sheet`](modifiers-presentation.md#sheet) modifier: Shows `content` in a sheet along the `side` edge.
- [`toast`](modifiers-presentation.md#toast) modifier: Posts the toast that `toast` makes when `presented` becomes true, and sets `presented` back to false.
- [`toaster`](modifiers-presentation.md#toaster) modifier: Shows the toasts that descendants post through `Env::toasts`, at `position` in the window.
- [`tooltip`](modifiers-presentation.md#tooltip) modifier: Shows `text` in a tooltip after the pointer rests on the view, or after keyboard focus moves into it.
- [`tooltip_on`](modifiers-presentation.md#tooltip_on) modifier: Shows `text` in a tooltip as `tooltip` does, on `side` of the view.

### Styling modifiers

- [`background`](modifiers-styling.md#background) modifier: Paints `fill` behind the view.
- [`border`](modifiers-styling.md#border) modifier: Strokes the view's edge inside its bounds.
- [`button_variant`](modifiers-styling.md#button_variant) modifier: The variant of buttons in the view that have none of their own.
- [`clip_shape`](modifiers-styling.md#clip_shape) modifier: Clips the content to the view's bounds and corner radius.
- [`color_scheme`](modifiers-styling.md#color_scheme) modifier: The color scheme of the view and its descendants.
- [`control_size`](modifiers-styling.md#control_size) modifier: The size of controls in the view that have none of their own.
- [`corner_radius`](modifiers-styling.md#corner_radius) modifier: Rounds the corners of the view's background, border, and clip.
- [`environment`](modifiers-styling.md#environment) modifier: Changes the environment of the view's descendants.
- [`foreground`](modifiers-styling.md#foreground) modifier: The color of text in the view.
- [`opacity`](modifiers-styling.md#opacity) modifier: Fades the view and its content.
- [`recipe`](modifiers-styling.md#recipe) modifier: Paints controls of `kind` in the view with `recipe`.
- [`ring`](modifiers-styling.md#ring) modifier: Strokes an outline just outside the view.
- [`shadow`](modifiers-styling.md#shadow) modifier: Paints a shadow under the view.
- [`theme`](modifiers-styling.md#theme) modifier: The base color and scheme of the view and its descendants.
- [`tint`](modifiers-styling.md#tint) modifier: The accent color of controls in the view: the primary role.
- [`token`](modifiers-styling.md#token) modifier: Replaces one color token in the view and its descendants.

### Text modifiers

- [`font_weight`](modifiers-text.md#font_weight) modifier: The font weight of text in the view.
- [`locale`](modifiers-text.md#locale) modifier: The locale of the view's text, and its layout direction.
- [`text_style`](modifiers-text.md#text_style) modifier: The text preset of text in the view.
- [`tracking`](modifiers-text.md#tracking) modifier: The letter spacing of text in the view.

## Styling

- [`BaseColor`](styling.md#basecolor) enum: The gray family a palette is built from.
- [`ButtonVariant`](styling.md#buttonvariant) enum: The look of a button.
- [`Color`](styling.md#color) struct: Straight-alpha sRGB color, stored as eight-bit channels.
- [`ColorRole`](styling.md#colorrole) enum: A semantic color slot.
- [`ColorScheme`](styling.md#colorscheme) enum: Light or dark appearance.
- [`ControlSize`](styling.md#controlsize) enum: The shared size scale.
- [`Corner`](styling.md#corner) enum: A corner radius: a step of the radius scale, or points.
- [`DesignTokens`](styling.md#designtokens) struct: Resolved design values.
- [`Elevation`](styling.md#elevation) enum: A shadow: a step of the elevation scale, or explicit layers.
- [`Fill`](styling.md#fill) enum: A color: a theme role, which follows the scheme and base color, or a fixed color.
- [`FocusFrame`](styling.md#focusframe) struct: Draws the focus ring around the focused node in `content`, above the content and outside the clip of containers inside it.
- [`FontWeight`](styling.md#fontweight) struct: CSS-style numeric weight, 1..=1000.
- [`Icon`](styling.md#icon) enum: A bundled line icon.
- [`Metric`](styling.md#metric) enum: A length: a step of the spacing scale, or points.

## Text

- [`Catalog`](text.md#catalog) struct: Translations keyed by locale tag and message id.
- [`IntoTextArg`](text.md#intotextarg) trait: Converts a text argument: a displayable value, a state handle, or a closure.
- [`Locale`](text.md#locale) struct: A parsed BCP 47 language tag, reduced to language and optional region.
- [`Localized`](text.md#localized) struct: A catalog string with its arguments, resolved through the environment's catalog and locale.
- [`Text`](text.md#text) struct: A run of text.
- [`TextContent`](text.md#textcontent) enum: What a `Text` shows: literal user data, or a catalog string.
- [`TextEnv`](text.md#textenv) struct: The text appearance that descendant text inherits.
- [`TextPreset`](text.md#textpreset) enum: The reference typography rules as named presets.
- [`t`](text.md#t) macro: A catalog string with arguments: `t!("count", n = count)`.

## Custom

- [`Canvas`](custom.md#canvas) struct: Custom drawing: `Canvas::new(|ctx, size| …)` draws with display-list commands in the space the canvas gets.
- [`CanvasContext`](custom.md#canvascontext) struct: What a `Canvas` draws with.
- [`Configured`](custom.md#configured) struct: A control of type `C` as a view.
- [`ControlContext`](custom.md#controlcontext) struct: What a control may do while handling an event.
- [`ControlEvent`](custom.md#controlevent) enum: Input delivered to a control.
- [`ControlRef`](custom.md#controlref) struct: The control that a view mounted, which the app can read after the mount, for example the scroll offset of a list.
- [`ControlView`](custom.md#controlview) struct: A control mounted as a view.
- [`CustomControl`](custom.md#customcontrol) trait: A control mounted in a `ControlHost`.
- [`CustomView`](custom.md#customview) trait: The low-level extension point for new controls: a type that measures, paints, reports semantics, and handles events through the control protocol.
- [`MeasureContext`](custom.md#measurecontext) struct: What a control reads while it measures or arranges.
- [`PaintContext`](custom.md#paintcontext) struct: Everything a control needs to paint one node: the display list, the node's bounds, the tokens, the style cache, text measurement, the layout direction, the messages, and the host's view of the node's state.
